reviewer: Codex, source adjudication in authorized Best of Game repair preparation
decisions: Only existing BP parents 8 and 9 and their exact reverse finish are verified here.
Each fact has independent Bulbapedia release-history and explicit ThePriceDex card-level variant evidence; no prices or inferred API flags contribute.
The regular-sized printings intrinsically bear the Winner stamp; no additional unstamped or Winner parents are proposed.
ReverseHolo taxonomy absence is not negative printing proof; preserve the discrepancy and exclude that source from affirmative votes.
New candidates use the explicit -RH public IDs. Every pre-existing -REV and -STD ID is preserved.
This scope does not certify the remaining base cards, Cosmos, Jumbo, separate Winner variants or whole-set completion.
